thread:
maria.docs: FYI opened a docs PR that touches the region availability table and adds explicit data residency clarifications for Canada and Brazil. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2147 — need a quick review before Thursday merge window.

jon.platform: scanning now. quick question — are we shipping the new SDK header snippet in this PR or just endpoint examples?

maria.docs: adding both. the SDK snippet demonstrates setting a region hint header for private deployments. included in the PR under /snippets/sdk-region-hint.md. snippet: 

```
# python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${{REDACTED}}")
client.default_headers.update({"X-Redwood-Region": "ca-central-1"})
```

kevin.eng: tiny nit — header casing. our runtime normalizes headers but docs should reflect what integration tests use. prefer `X-Redwood-Region` (camel-case) in examples.

maria.docs: good call — updated the snippet to `X-Redwood-Region`. thanks.

lisa.docs: can we add a short note under the Data residency section clarifying that routing to a region != guaranteed persistent storage in that region unless residency is enabled? draft sentence: "Selecting a region routes inference to that region, but persistent storage of requests/responses is only guaranteed when Data Residency is explicitly enabled in account settings or covered by an enterprise residency contract."

sam.security: +1. important to be explicit. also add a link to the residency contract page and the KMS/HSM note for private deployments.

jon.platform: I added a small "feature parity" row to the table: CA -> embeddings + chat + reranking; BR -> chat only (no dedicated infra yet). verified with infra that BR currently has no reserved-capacity offering. set token-logs support to "no" for BR.

maria.docs: perfect — I'll include that matrix row and update the migration guide snippet for SDK (small note about fallback behavior if region not available).

docs-bot: Preview site build succeeded — https://deploy-preview-2147--redwood-docs.netlify.app/regions/geo-parity-check

maria.docs: planning to merge in ~15m unless anyone objects. :shipit: :+1:

kevin.eng: no objections from infra. looks good.

lisa.docs: merging after one quick spelling pass. thanks all!
